title: Enhance product management with easier stock editing and total inventory value display

requirements.text: Add quick stock adjustment controls to the ProductManagementTable component including increment (+) and decrement (-) buttons next to the inventory count field that modify stock by 1 per click without entering edit mode

quotes: Make the manage productos page easier to edit stock details

acceptanceCriteria: Increment (+) and decrement (-) buttons appear next to each product's inventory count in the table
Clicking increment increases stock by 1 and immediately saves via backend
Clicking decrement decreases stock by 1 (minimum 0) and immediately saves via backend
Stock changes update the product without requiring full row edit mode
Loading state shown during stock update operations
Toast notification displays success or error after stock change

requirements.text: Add a total inventory value calculator section to the Dashboard page that displays the sum of (price × inventory count) for all listed products, showing the potential value of all stock

quotes: reflect potential valie of all listed items

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays a new statistics card showing 'Total Inventory Value' alongside existing metrics
Value is calculated as the sum of (product price × inventory count) for all products
Display formats the value as currency (e.g., '$1,234.56')
Value updates automatically when products are added, edited, or deleted
Calculation includes all products regardless of their availability status

requirements.text: Create backend helper method getTotalInventoryValue() that calculates and returns the sum of (price × inventory count) across all products in the system

quotes: reflect potential valie of all listed items

acceptanceCriteria: Method iterates through all products and calculates price × inventory for each
Returns the total sum as a Nat representing the monetary value
Method is accessible to authenticated admin users
Calculation handles products with zero inventory correctly
Performance remains acceptable even with large product catalogs

requirements.text: Create React Query hook useTotalInventoryValue in useQueries.ts that fetches the total inventory value from the backend with automatic refetching when product data changes

quotes: reflect potential valie of all listed items

acceptanceCriteria: Hook fetches total inventory value from backend getTotalInventoryValue() method
Hook requires admin authentication via useActor
Query invalidates and refetches when products query invalidates
Returns loading, error, and data states for UI consumption
Integrates with existing React Query setup in the project

constraints: Maintain single-actor backend architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify read-only frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Use existing ProductManagementTable component structure without breaking current inline editing functionality
Follow existing authentication patterns using Internet Identity and admin token
Preserve existing React Query patterns and invalidation logic
nonGoals: Changing product pricing or inventory management outside the product management table
Implementing inventory alerts or low-stock notifications
Modifying Stripe checkout or payment flows
